An extended look into Crombie’s experiment. 

In ONTOS, you play as Aditi as she explores the repurposed moon hotel Samsara and encounters strange Experiments and other disturbing scenarios. Your morality will be tested. 
 
In this video, we’ll take you deeper into one such experiment led by Crombie, a scientist drawn to Samsara in search of answers about the essence of one’s unique, individual self.  
 
Do you trust the machine? Do you seek an alternative approach? 
 
You must investigate the environment, look for hidden clues, and decide which steps to take.  
 
ONTOS is coming to PS5 in 2027.

text:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Relic Expedition Gameplay Overview | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0102-PPSA09663_00-DD2DA00000000000

Venture forth, Arisen, to the Forsaken Dominion of Norgan, where powerful treasures are just waiting to be discovered! Get ready for the perilous journey ahead with this gameplay overview video, which chronicles the evolution of Dark Arisen's signature loot-based Relic Expedition Cycle gameplay in Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen.
 
Get ready for the Dark Arisen Expansion's launch by jumping back into Dragon's Dogma 2 with the newly released free Title Update! Performance improvements, more save slots and save system adjustments, increased skill slots, and a host of other improvements await!

About Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen

Your unwritten epic begins in Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, coming to PS5 October 9, 2026. 

The dynamic fantasy world is expanded with new tales and thrilling encounters. Embark to a snowy new area in the north: the long-abandoned Norgan region, and take on 12 new dungeon challenges spread across the existing world of Dragon's Dogma 2. Also, bring your Arisen and Pawns to life with new hairstyles and tattoo options.

The base Dragon's Dogma 2 game is being improved with Free Title Updates. The first update is available now and adds quality-of-life improvements, including an Eternal Ferrystone and more Portcrystals. A second update in late August will bring framerate and performance improvements to all platforms, additional save slots, and many more adjustments and improvements. 

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen contains both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content in one package. The Dark Arisen Expansion will be available as a separate DLC on PS5.
